parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Wood for 1 Sheep. Looking at my resources, I have 3 Sheep, 1 Wheat, and 2 Wood. While I already have some Wood, my Brick production (Hex 5, Node 20) is currently blocked by the robber. I need Brick and Wheat to build my next settlement at Node 33. However, I have a surplus of Sheep (3) and the trade is a 1:1 ratio. Wood is useful for roads, and since I'm currently blocked on Brick, having extra Wood doesn't hurt for future expansion once I secure Brick. Jimmy has been uncooperative, and although Claude betrayed me in the past, this specific trade is fair and helps me diversify slightly while getting rid of a Sheep I have in excess. I will accept to keep the game moving, but stay wary of Claude.
parsed.note_to_self: Accepted 1 Wood from Claude for 1 Sheep. Current resources: 3 Wood, 2 Sheep, 1 Wheat. Still need Brick to build at Node 33 (Wheat 6/9).
parsed.say_outloud: טוב קלוד, עשית עסקה. כבשים באמת יש לי מספיק ועץ תמיד יכול לעזור כשהכל פה תקוע. מקווה שזה לא יתפוצץ לי בפרצוף אחר כך.
